## Install

1. Download **HushBrowser-VERSION.dmg** below and open it.
2. Drag **Hush Browser** onto the **Applications** folder.
3. Open Hush from Applications. macOS will say it can't verify Hush, because Hush isn't signed with a
   paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**, then go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**,
   scroll to **Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to Hush Browser. You only do this once.

Hush updates itself from here: new versions install the next time you quit it, or straight away from
**Settings › Software Update**.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/danxharvard/hushbrowser/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what's new.
